_doc: Awareness levels + business perks (m-25026482). Brands and products are REUSED from the repo's anonymised eval case files, nothing new from a database: the shawarma-and-salads shop of ../mejorar_texto/cases.json (perks = the founder's own example for food, 2026-11-13), the ice-cream shop and the real-estate advisor of ../copy_ai/cases.json (perks taken from that brand's own case topics: hel-05, hel-06, hel-07; inm-02, inm-03 and its kit's CTAs), the travel agency of ../reels_ai/cases.json (Cusco, Peru — the only travel brand in the repo's cases; its perks are written for this eval from its bio and flagged). Prices only where a case already states one (mejorar_texto combo-almuerzo 25.000, copy_ai hel-02 9.000, inm-01 280 millones). Split: dev cases tune the judge and the regexes, test cases are reported and never tuned on. Every angle case runs twice with the new prompt (with perks, with none) and once with the baseline prompt (which cannot read perks).
